integrity: A complete analytic proof is supplied; a reproducible exact-arithmetic and numerical supplementary checker is included. Finite tests are not substituted for infinite-dimensional arguments. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Only real nonnegative distinct poles below one with two known and equal unit masses; spectral observation consists solely of two positive eigenvalues. No claims about general masses, complex poles, larger atom counts, or recovery from enriched spectral data. Specialist historical-priority checks could find equivalent formulations.
title: A sharp trace-nine inverse-spectral bifurcation for two-pole Hankel operators
